customHeaders: No general static-header configuration documented for ChatGPT HTTPS apps.

caveat.en: Prefer Secure Tunnel. HTTPS also supports OAuth with local app consent via agent-remote-control:// or authenticated CLI consent. Tunnel access and client developer-mode permissions are separate.
caveat.zh-CN: 优先 Secure Tunnel；HTTPS 也支持本机应用确认的 OAuth。Tunnel 与客户端开发者模式权限分别管理。

customHeaders: Organization administrators can configure Authorization or x-api-key in static_headers beta.

caveat.en: OAuth uses local app consent via agent-remote-control:// or authenticated CLI consent and DCR or preregistered client credentials. Organization static-header beta can still use Bearer. Verify the client registration flow.
caveat.zh-CN: OAuth 使用本机应用确认或已认证 CLI 确认，支持动态注册或预注册客户端凭据。组织静态请求头 Beta 仍可使用 Bearer；需确认客户端注册流程。

customHeaders: Grok web Custom Connector has no static Authorization header field.

caveat.en: In Grok, open Plugins → New Connector → Custom and enter the MCP URL. Use OAuth with local app consent. The public endpoint must also forward OAuth discovery and authorization routes. Grok Bot remains a custom control source.
caveat.zh-CN: 在 Grok 中打开 Plugins → New Connector → Custom，填写 MCP URL，通过本机应用确认 OAuth。公网入口还需转发 OAuth 发现与授权路由。Grok Bot 继续使用自定义控制源。

customHeaders: Copilot Studio API-key Header accepts a configured header name.

caveat.en: Copilot Studio can use Authorization: Bearer <token> through API-key headers, or OAuth with registered client credentials. Verify actual tenant compatibility. Other API-key headers are not implemented.
caveat.zh-CN: Copilot Studio 可通过 API key 请求头使用 Authorization: Bearer，或使用已注册客户端凭据接入 OAuth；需确认租户兼容性。尚无其他 API key 请求头。

caveat.en: Notion Custom Agents support header authentication via Authorization: Bearer <token>. Notion requires an eligible plan and workspace permissions.
caveat.zh-CN: Notion Custom Agents 支持通过 Authorization: Bearer 请求头认证。使用此功能需满足 Notion 的套餐和工作区权限要求。

customHeaders: Custom headers in Slack documentation apply to identity requests, not arbitrary MCP request headers.

caveat.en: OAuth supports dynamic or local preregistration and local app consent via agent-remote-control:// or authenticated CLI consent. Verify the Slack client flow. Signed Slack identity is not implemented; Bearer is not compatible.
caveat.zh-CN: OAuth 支持动态注册或本机预注册，通过本机应用或已认证 CLI 确认，需核对 Slack 客户端流程。尚未实现 Slack 身份签名；不支持 Bearer。

caveat.en: Configure a remote MCP URL and Authorization: Bearer <token>. Use a client version that forwards configured headers; verify the actual request.
caveat.zh-CN: 配置远程 MCP URL 与 Authorization: Bearer；客户端版本须支持转发配置的请求头，并验证实际请求。

customHeaders: Remote headers supported; configuration differs by host.

caveat.en: Available in supported VS Code, JetBrains and CLI surfaces; use each host’s HTTP MCP configuration and Authorization: Bearer <token>. Host capabilities and organization policy differ.
caveat.zh-CN: 可承载在支持的 VS Code、JetBrains、CLI；按宿主配置 HTTP MCP 与 Authorization: Bearer。宿主能力及组织策略不同。

customHeaders: HTTP Headers are sent on every request.

caveat.en: AI Chat, Quick AI and AI Commands use HTTP MCP. Set Authorization: Bearer <token> in HTTP Headers; Raycast AI plan availability applies.
caveat.zh-CN: AI Chat、Quick AI、AI Commands 使用 HTTP MCP；HTTP Headers 填 Authorization: Bearer，需相应 Raycast AI 套餐。
